fix: allow Mapbox GL JS in the web-admin CSP so canvas maps load in Rill Cloud (#9935)

The canvas map component (#8931) works in Rill Developer but never loads in
Rill Cloud because web-admin's Content Security Policy blocks it:

- mapbox-gl creates its tile-parsing Web Worker from a blob: URL. With no
  worker-src directive the browser falls back to script-src, which does not
  allow blob:.
- Style JSON, sprites, glyphs and tiles are fetched from api.mapbox.com, and
  telemetry goes to events.mapbox.com; neither was in connect-src.

Add worker-src/child-src 'self' blob: and the two Mapbox hosts to
connect-src, matching Mapbox's documented CSP requirements for GL JS v3.
img-src already allows https: data: blob:. Verified in headless Chromium
that the light-v11 and dark-v11 styles now fire `load` with no CSP
violations under the exact policy emitted by svelte.config.js.

Also add web-admin/src/csp.spec.ts so a future CSP edit cannot silently
break the map.

(cherry picked from commit 9d0ffa24adb79d22f8b245f8f1fab74ca0db0b9d)

fix: restore measure filters on comparison accessors (#9939)

Measure filters on `<measure>_delta`, `<measure>_delta_perc` and
`<measure>_percent_of_total` were dropped when parsing the filter param.
`JoinerFilterManager.parse` keyed the measure manager on the suffixed
identifier, which is not a measure in the metrics view, so the manager was
never created. Strip the suffix with the existing `stripMeasureSuffix`
helper so the chip is created for the base measure; `reconcile` already
reads the comparison type back from the having expression.

(cherry picked from commit 8d44276827685078b8d1058fa3f019c3c81be0a6)

Always serve the skill tools on the runtime MCP server and return runtime tool errors as tool results in `admin/server/mcp.go` (#9934)

* fix: return runtime tool errors as MCP tool results in the admin MCP server

The admin service's unified MCP server advertises the skill tools for every project,
but the runtime only serves them for projects that define skills.
Calling list_skills or load_skill on a project without skills therefore made the runtime
reject the call as an unknown tool, which callRuntimeTool surfaced as a protocol error the client could not recover from.

callRuntimeTool now returns the runtime's invalid params errors, which cover both unknown tools and invalid arguments,
as tool results with isError set, matching the handler's intent of returning tool errors for anything the caller can act on.
For the skill tools, the unknown tool error is replaced with a message explaining that the project defines no skills.
Other errors from the runtime remain protocol errors.

* feat: always serve the skill tools on the runtime's MCP server

The runtime only served list_skills and load_skill for projects that define skills.
That made the tool set differ per project, and the admin service's unified MCP server,
which advertises the same tools for every project, had to special case the runtime's unknown tool error.

The skill tools are now served for every caller with the UseAI permission:
list_skills returns an empty list and load_skill a not-found error when the project defines no skills.
The in-app agents already decide for themselves whether to offer the tools, so their tool lists are unchanged.
The admin service keeps returning the runtime's invalid params errors as tool results, but no longer needs a skill-specific message.

* Fix stale comments about the skill tools being hidden without skills

(cherry picked from commit 40b75f7383c4c0db3cce6586136a65a03dd49677)

fix: key dashboard favourites and breadcrumbs by `kind/name` (#9931)

* fix: key dashboard favourites and breadcrumbs by `kind/name`

#9918 changed dashboard table row ids to `kind/name`, but favourites were
still stored as lowercase names and passed straight through as pinned row
ids. TanStack throws `getRow could not find row with ID` for a pinned id
with no matching row, so the dashboards list crashed for anyone with a
favourite.

Key favourites, recently-used timestamps and breadcrumb options by
`resourceKey(kind, name)` so an explore and a canvas sharing a name are
distinct everywhere, and migrate legacy name-only localStorage entries.

* fix: keep unmatched legacy favourites and migrate stores from one place

Unmatched legacy name-only entries are retained instead of pruned: the
dashboards list excludes unshared admin-managed canvases, so pruning could
permanently drop a favourite. Unmatched keys are ignored when pinning.

Both per-project stores are now migrated by a single helper called from
ProjectHeader, which is mounted on every project page and already loads
the dashboards list, instead of separate effects in two components.

(cherry picked from commit 9bf4a6ad9545d60f08b48cca797a86307229ad77)

fix: remove `web-admin/src/csp.spec.ts` so the tsc whitelist check passes again (#9941)

* fix: remove `web-admin/src/csp.spec.ts` so the tsc whitelist check passes again

#9935 added this spec, which imports `svelte.config.js` and so pulled it into
the type checked program for the first time. With `checkJs` that surfaced
TS18048 in the spec and TS2322 in the config, failing
`scripts/tsc-with-whitelist.sh` and the web unit tests on every PR.

The Mapbox directives it asserted stay in `svelte.config.js` unchanged.

* ci: run `svelte-kit sync` in web-common before the web-admin unit tests

web-common/tsconfig.json extends the gitignored .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json.
Previously it was generated only as a side effect of the web-common test step,
which is skipped for PRs that do not touch web-common/**, so web-admin-only PRs
failed with TSCONFIG_ERROR on every spec importing from web-common.

(cherry picked from commit e368d71d9c17db5677658d51b9d51412a2c42de2)

fix: keep dimension filters with `EQ`, `NEQ` and other binary operators (#9938)

The unified expression filter refactor only modelled IN/NIN/LIKE/NLIKE in
`DimensionFilterManager.reconcile`. Any other operator ended up in Select mode
with no values, so `commit()` produced no expression and the filter was silently
dropped from queries and from the URL. Canvas `defaults.filters` written with `=`
hit the same path via `flattenExpression` + `convertExpressionToFilterParam`.

- `EQ`/`NEQ` are read as a single value Select filter (IN/NIN with one value),
  reusing `maybeConvertEqualityToInExpressions`.
- Any other operator (`GT`, `LTE`, ...) is kept verbatim on the manager so it
  still applies and round trips through the URL. An edit of the chip replaces it.
- `mergeFilterParams` flags such a condition as advanced, so the filter bar shows
  the read only advanced filter instead of an empty chip.

(cherry picked from commit b5dbdd1626895bc376b346f77b0bbb9309154a76)

fix: pass pre-invoked tool results to the `develop_file` sub-agent (#9936)

The sub-agent seeded its completion messages with
`FilterByParent(s.ID())`, the session ID, but `Session.AddMessage` parents
pre-invoked calls to `s.ParentID`, the current tool call ID. Nothing
matched, so the `list_files`, `project_status`, `read_file` and skill
preload results were silently dropped and the sub-agent ran without them.

Use `FilterByParent(s.ParentID)` like `developer_agent` and
`analyst_agent` do, and add a test asserting the first completion request
carries each seeded call paired with its result, including the
always-apply developer skill.

(cherry picked from commit 02f735a93903c94c90bd641d9c259dcfd90d7359)

fix: dimension table freezes when resizing the dimension column (#9944)

Since #9746 migrated DimensionTable.svelte to runes, the column width $effect
assigned estimateColumnSize and then read it back through
estimateColumnSize[0] = manualDimensionColumnWidth. In Svelte 5 an effect that
reads a source it just wrote registers it as a dependency and reschedules
itself, so the first manual resize looped until effect_update_depth_exceeded.
Compute the widths as a $derived instead.
fix: pylon csp error with their new domain (#9945)
Update GoReleaser to use name template for install script upload (#9946)
Add `.` directory to GoReleaser config for install script (#9947)
fix: cap the ephemeral measure dialog height so many measures do not overflow the viewport (#9949)

fix: uneven bottom padding in `BookmarksTable` rows (#9950)

* fix: uneven bottom padding in bookmarks list rows

* fix: keep resource badge at natural height in bookmarks list rows

fix: skip home bookmarks in the bookmark listings (#9952)

Opening a dashboard already shows its home view, so a home bookmark row only duplicated the dashboard's own link and read as a meaningless "Go to Home" or "Home" entry when a project has many dashboards.
stop doing ping in getDB (#9943)

fix: explore filters break when the explore's `metrics_view` differs in case from the resource name (#9955)

Resource names are case-insensitive in the runtime, so an explore whose `metrics_view` is written in a different case than the metrics view file still reconciles. On the frontend, `MetricsViewsProvider` looked the metrics view up with a case-sensitive comparison and came up empty, so the filter bar had nothing to offer and click-to-filter no-oped. `ExploreDashboardConfigProvider` also named the metrics view by the explore's reference while the explore routes use the resource name, so the filter expression was keyed under a name the dashboard never read and queries ran unfiltered.

- Resolve the metrics view case-insensitively in `MetricsViewsProvider`.
- Name the metrics view by its resource name in `ExploreDashboardConfigProvider`.
- Let the explore fetch mock carry a metrics view resource name that differs from the explore's reference.

feat(ai): invoke a project skill with `/` in every chat surface (#9932)

The `/` skill picker was only enabled for the project chat. It now
opens in every chat: the picker lists the skills for the agent that
answers the chat (analyst for project, embed, explore and canvas chats;
developer for the developer chat), and the developer agent pre-invokes
load_skill for the skills referenced in the prompt like the analyst
already did. Since the developer's model only sees the current turn's
tool calls, a referenced skill is loaded again on each turn.
feat: one-shot `Fit to width` action for pivot tables (#9954)

fix: dimension table search ignored when the dashboard has no active filters (#9951)

`getDimensionFilterWithSearch` returned undefined when the where filter was
undefined, which is now the case for a dashboard with no active filters since
the unified expression filter refactor (#9746). The search text was dropped
and the dimension table query ran without a where clause.

Treat an undefined filter as an empty AND so the search clause is still added.

feat: drag and drop, and duplicate, canvas tab groups (#9929)

* feat: drag and drop canvas tab groups to reorder them on the page

Tab groups were fixed at the position they were created in: tabs could be reordered
within a group, but the group itself could not be moved. In edit mode the tab strip
now has a grip handle, and pressing on it (or on the strip's empty area) lifts the
whole group so it can be dropped into any top-level row slot, the same way a widget
is dragged.

- `moveTabGroup` in tab-edit splices the group to a drop slot index.
- The canvas entity carries the active tab across the move; an unnamed group is
  keyed by its row index, so moving it otherwise rebuilt the group on its first tab.
- The builder mirrors the move in the optimistic spec before persisting the YAML.
- Only top-level row drop zones accept a dragged group; zones inside tabs, column
  zones and tab labels stay inert.

* feat: duplicate a whole canvas tab group

Individual tabs could be duplicated but not the group as a whole. `duplicateTabGroup`
copies every tab and its rows into a new group inserted right after the original,
dropping the group's `name` so the copy gets a fresh URL key. It is offered as a
"Duplicate tab group" button in the tab group inspector and from each tab's menu in
the strip; the copy is selected afterwards, like a duplicated tab.

* fix: re-key index-named tab groups on move and duplicate; allow-list the strip's drag targets

Unnamed tab groups are keyed `group-<rowIndex>`, so moving or duplicating a group
shifted the keys of every unnamed group whose row changed, and the next layout pass
handed each of them a neighbour's instance (wrong open tab, inspector pointing at a
different group). Carrying only the dragged group's tab across was not enough.

`CanvasEntity.rekeyTabGroups` now re-keys every affected group ahead of the edit using
a row index mapping, so each instance follows its group with its active tab and the
selection intact. This replaces the pending-activation workaround. The pure helpers
(`rekeyedTabGroupNames`, `rowIndexAfterMove`) are unit tested.

The strip's mousedown filter excluded `button`/`input` targets but only for HTML
elements, so pressing on a button's SVG icon (e.g. the add-tab `+`) started a drag.
It is now an allow list: only the grip and the strip's own background start one.

feat: `@` measure picker in the adhoc measure expression input (#9953)

* feat: `@` measure picker in the adhoc measure expression input

Typing `@` in the expression opens a picker of the referenceable measures, searchable by display name as well as field name, so users no longer need to know a measure's field name to reference it. Picking one inserts the (quoted if needed) field name. Shared by the explore dialog and the canvas inspector editor.

* feat: measure chips, unique display names and descriptions for adhoc measures

Picked measures now render as chips showing the display name, like mentions in the AI chat, and serialize to the field name; existing expressions are tokenized into chips when the editor opens. A display name that another measure already uses is rejected. Definitions gain an optional description, carried in the `adhoc_m` URL param and the canvas YAML, and shown in tooltips instead of the expression.

* fix: adhoc measure review feedback

The "Insert a measure" buttons insert a chip into the expression editor again (they set the parent's string, which the editor only read on mount). A display name that repeats another measure's gets a numeric suffix via `getName`, following the codebase norm, instead of an error. The chip tokenizer walks the expression parser's tree, which now reports reference spans, instead of a regex.

* refactor: share the adhoc measure form between explore and canvas

The explore dialog and the canvas inspector editor duplicated the form fields, validation and footer. `EphemeralMeasureForm` now owns those; the two remaining files only supply the referenceable measures and persist the definition to the explore state or the component spec.

feat: download any canvas component as a PNG (`CanvasComponentPngDialog`) (#9930)

* feat: download any canvas component as a PNG from its toolbar

- Adds a "Download as PNG" preview dialog for canvas components, framed
  with the dashboard title, time range and filters like explore's export
- Extracts the PDF export's rasterizer into a shared, format-aware module
- View-mode toolbar gains a menu so every component type can export

* fix: rename the canvas component menu label so it no longer matches the inspector's Options tab in e2e locators

* fix: keep the explore jump in the canvas card's corner slot in view mode

The component menu now sits inward of it, so the spot users already aim
for keeps taking them to explore.

feat(ai): admin-configured starter prompts for dashboard and project chat (`ai_prompts`) (#9948)

* feat(ai): suggested starter prompts for dashboard and project chat (`ai_prompts`)

- `ai_prompts` list on explore, canvas and rill.yaml; shown verbatim in the empty chat
- Explore and canvas reconcilers generate prompts via the AI connector after writing the valid spec, hash-gated in resource state, never failing the dashboard
- Project prompts flow from rill.yaml into the instance record and API
- Frontend chips in the sidebar and full-page chat empty state with hardcoded i18n fallback
- Docs and reference schema updates

* refactor(ai): show only admin-configured `ai_prompts`, drop LLM generation and fallback prompts

- Remove reconcile-time prompt generation, the `ai_suggested_prompts` state fields and the mock AI test additions
- Remove the hardcoded fallback prompts; the chat shows the dashboard's `ai_prompts`, else the project's, else nothing
- Update docs and schema wording

* fix(ai): address review on `ai_prompts` chips

- Pass the shared query client to the resource and instance queries created inside derived stores, which re-run outside component initialization
- Show every configured prompt instead of capping the list at 4; the parser limit of 8 is the single source of truth
- Reject duplicate prompts in the parser and key the prompt list by index

* fix(ai): clone `ai_prompts` before assigning them to the instance

Sharing proto messages between the parser and the cached instance let
GetInstance marshalling mutate the parser's copy, which made the rill.yaml
change check report spurious changes and caused a data race.

test: wait for the trial job before setting the e2e org quota (#9957)

The trial job started after the first deploy writes the org's quotas when it finishes,
which could revert the project quota set by the e2e setup.
Wait for the trial billing issue, which is written after the quotas, before setting it.
